article.title: The Chinese Idolize Free Trade
article.excerpt: The Hindustan Times reports: They have taken over our toys, cutlery, nail-cutters and other sundry items. And this Diwali [Festival of Lights] they have taken over our Gods as well. Meet Lord Ganesha and Goddess Laxmi – made in China, sold in India. Showrooms and giftshops are flooded with Chinese idols and electric diyas. And consumers are lapping them
